obligations.target: Verify scan route short-circuits requests containing 'favicon' by responding with 404 and empty body
obligations.reason: Unit tests against the route handler can directly verify the status code and empty body response when favicon is requested.

obligations.target: Verify scan requests lacking vendor code and active session redirect to /setup with badge id parameter
obligations.reason: Route handler unit test verifies redirect status and location header. Navigation flow would gain e2e-playwright coverage at thorough.

obligations.target: Verify scan with explicit vendor code renders confirmation and stores code in session for subsequent requests
obligations.reason: Unit test validates response content and session persistence across consecutive handler calls. Multi-step browser flow would gain e2e-playwright coverage at thorough.

obligations.target: Verify scan without explicit code succeeds by reusing vendor code saved in session from setup
obligations.reason: Unit test verifies that the handler resolves vendor code from session context and outputs the confirmation view. Cross-endpoint user flow would gain e2e-playwright coverage at thorough.

obligations.target: Verify scan error page and message "That code didn't look right." when query returns zero records
obligations.reason: Unit test isolates query response returning zero records and asserts error view rendering with the exact error message.

obligations.target: Verify URL-encoded vendor code segment is correctly decoded and rendered in confirmation page
obligations.reason: Unit test verifies parameter decoding logic and checks decoded string in template rendering output.

obligations.target: Verify POST scan request with vendor code and optional note renders confirmation page
obligations.reason: Unit test verifies POST body parsing with optional note and asserts confirmation view output.
